@common.sizeUnit.byte.sameAsSourceJustification: Vietnamese nouns don't inflect, so one `other` arm with the loanword `byte`, exactly as macOS vi Foundation `FileSizeFormatting.loctable` writes it (`bytes` → `byte`, `Zero bytes` → `0 byte`; verified on macOS 26, plutil, 2026-10-06) and as the shipped `settings.listing.sizeUnit.opt.bytes` (`Byte`).

@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary unit symbol: Vietnamese keeps the Latin IEC symbols, as KDE Dolphin vi (` MiB` → ` MiB`) and Xfce Thunar vi write them; vi has no localized binary prefix, and Latin keeps it distinct from the decimal symbols (MB, GB).

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI unit symbol: vi keeps Latin size symbols, as macOS vi Foundation `FileSizeFormatting.loctable` does for MB/GB/TB/PB (verified on macOS 26, plutil, 2026-10-06); the lowercase SI k (macOS writes KB) keeps it distinct from the binary KiB, matching the English source.

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: macOS vi Foundation `FileSizeFormatting.loctable` keeps KB/MB/GB/TB/PB as Latin symbols (verified on macOS 26, plutil, 2026-10-06), and Finder vi (`SP24`–`SP26`) agrees.
